title: Blur: adjustment layer and mask
text: New adjustment layer, Gaussian Blur, then the Ellipse or Rectangle mask tool in Effect Controls; feather the mask. Don't copy the user's layers or stack crops to fake a shape. Masks have no API, so the mask tools are a Premiere UI route still to be proven; explore Premiere's own tools before working around them.
